graph:
Recreate the attached reference graph for a technical conference slide using tactile editorial cut-paper collage, in the same style as the second reference image. First image is the STRUCTURE/TEXT reference; second is STYLE reference only. Wide 16:9 canvas, warm ivory textured paper background #f2ebdd, teal torn paper, mustard yellow paper accents, black Archivo-like typography, deep signal red #b92a19 directional arrows. Keep the graph logically exact, ALL listed text verbatim, all labels legible. Avoid generic UI cards, use torn paper areas and small photographic cutouts integrated with the diagram. Composition consists of three distinct regions separated by generous empty gutters: THE LOOP occupies x=3%-28%; THE HARNESS x=35%-59%; THE FACTORY x=67%-98%. All stage content remains strictly in its own region. Left-to-right connector arrows are in gutters only. All regions start at 12% canvas height and end by 88%, so nothing is clipped. No overall border.
LEFT heading "THE LOOP". Large circular arrow diagram with "context" at top, "act" at lower left, "verify" at lower right; center label "one agent". Bottom caption "gather → act → verify → repeat". A small vintage computer photographic cutout may accompany the center. Correct cycle is context → act → verify → context. Gutter to middle: red arrow labeled "wrap it".
MIDDLE heading "THE HARNESS". A teal paper enclosure containing a small circle labeled "loop", alongside three distinct stacked torn-paper labels "sandbox", "tools", "memory". Below these, a yellow paper gate strip labeled exactly 'gates: what "done" means'. Small tool/key and notebook photo cutouts can decorate but do not obscure text. Bottom caption "a loop, given walls". Gutter to right: red arrow labeled "run many".
RIGHT heading "THE FACTORY". Three stacked separate paper strips each labeled "harness", each with its own arrow converging into a single yellow paper gate labeled on two lines "review" and "/ merge". That gate has ONE outgoing arrow into a teal paper strip labeled "prod". Above the review gate show a small black-and-white human portrait or silhouette labeled "you" with subtitle "the outer loop". Bottom caption on two short lines "many loops, at scale," and "drained through one gate". Keep factory nested routing EXACTLY three harnesses -> one review/merge -> prod, with human above review.
Use highly readable black text, generous spacing and modest photographic details. Match editorial texture and typography from the style reference. No unrelated objects, no extra labels, no watermark.
